warrants.quote: In addition, the Company issued 38,125 agent warrants. The agent warrants are immediately exercisable for a period of five years from the closing date at an exercise price of $5.00 per share.
All warrants have an exercise price of $5.25 per share, are immediately exercisable, and expire five years from the date of issuance
